title: Park Cleanup
description: Volunteer Information Subscribe to our e-mail list to be notified of upcoming events. The McKinney Parks Foundation is a nonprofit formed exclusively by volunteers. We offer volunteer workdays along the trails of McKinney and at the East McKinney Learning Garden. MPF Board Volunteers Volunteer of the Year 2022 Volunteers Volunteers If you’re looking for unique opportunities to volunteer at a McKinney Park with your group, business, or organization, contact the McKinney Parks Foundation president at mckinneyparksfoundation@gmail.com to schedule your individual volunteer day. This would include individual projects, including building birdhouses, bug boxes, boardwalks, garden installation, prairie conservation, trail maintenance, and litter pick up. There are many committees with positions open on the McKinney Parks Foundation board. Please join us at our next Board Meeting to join the Board or a committee and make a difference in the community! title: VolunTEEN Program
description: Become a VolunTEEN The VolunTEEN Corps is a community service initiative that offers middle and high school students an opportunity for civic involvement. VolunTEENs will enrich personal skills, enhance job skills, and gain work experience that can be included on resumes. VolunTEENs develop a better understanding of city government, serve as ambassadors within the community, and accumulate community service hours for school. Have questions? Submit your question using the form below. MIDDLE SCHOOL VOLUNTEEN For Frisco Residents ONLY going into Grades 7 or 8 in Fall 2026. This program is currently full. We expect to have limited spots available for next summer 2027. We will update this page with more instructions sometime in March 2027. Please read the FAQs , where many questions about tasks, procedures, and rules are answered. If you have a question that isn't covered, please use the webform at the bottom of this page. The purpose of this program is to allow middle school teens in the Frisco area a chance to earn service hours, volunteer in a supportive environment, and grow as an individual while contributing to the Library. VolunTEENs will be credited service hours for the time spent volunteering during scheduled shifts. *The Library does not guarantee that each participant will earn a certain number of volunteer hours. FAQs HERE . HIGH SCHOOL VOLUNTEEN For Frisco Residents ONLY going into Grades 9 – 12 in Fall 2026. This program is currently full. We expect to have limited spots available for next summer 2027.
